text:
emma (AE): opening thread for Helios Systems POC — they need SSO (SAML) + SCIM group sync + RBAC mappings and strict tenant domain-locking. target start next Mon, 2-week window. who can own bits?
emma (AE): attached their security questionnaire and IdP metadata link. cc @raj for setup, @luke for security responses, @jordan for pricing/SOW.
raj (SE): I can take setup. quick Q: SP vs IdP initiated? need their entityID and ACS. also confirm SCIM: group push + department->role mapping?
emma (AE): they prefer SP-initiated. SCIM mapping: department->role + support for nested groups. incremental sync required.
luke (Infosec): questionnaire concerns: assertion signing alg, NameID format, replay protection, assertion TTL, audit retention, and domain ownership proof for tenant lock. do they insist on customer-managed certs/HSM for SAML?
jordan (CS): Pricing/SOW note: recommend evaluation credits to cover connector work for POC, include manual allowlist fallback option and an optional Dedicated quote. I'll draft SOW.
raj (SE): for POC we use our SP cert by default; we can support customer certs if they need it. SCIM: we support incremental + soft-delete with configurable deprovision latency (typically <2min for push).
luke (Infosec): domain lock flow: we validate domain ownership via DNS TXT at apex. they must add TXT record before we can enable automated tenant lock. that could block production cutover; POC can run without DNS by using manual tenant binding.
emma (AE): Helios says DNS changes need legal sign-off and might take a week. can't delay start. what's the manual option?
raj (SE): manual option = explicit tenant binding in Console + IP allowlist for Helios office ranges during POC. note: not allowed for production; document that.
jordan (CS): SOW will include clause: manual binding allowed for evaluation only; production requires DNS TXT verification. also include connector fee waived for POC; if they convert within 30 days waive first-month connector fee.
luke (Infosec): security answers (summary): signing alg = rsa-sha256, NameID = email address preferred, assertion TTL = 5m recommended, replay protection = enabled, audit logs = 90d default (extendable), customer-managed HSM = enterprise add-on + ATO. will send full questionnaire doc.
raj (SE): I'll post a minimal SCIM mapping sample in the gdoc: `{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"mappings":[{"source":"department","target":"urn:company:attrs:role"},{"source":"groups","target":"urn:company:attrs:nestedGroups"}]}`
raj (SE): SAML endpoints: SP-ACS = https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs, SP-entityID = https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata. we accept SHA256 signatures and can support encrypted assertions.
staging-bot: deploy started: scim-syncer v2.0 -> staging cluster.
raj (SE): deploy success. sample provisioning log: SUCCESS user=hlee@helios.com groups=[engineering,staff] role=engineering. will attach logs to gdoc.
luke (Infosec): if Helios insists on tenant lock before POC start, escalate their DNS admin to eng-ops and loop legal for approvals.
emma (AE): I'll ping Helios DNS contact now and ask for a point-of-contact who can make TXT changes. deadline: need decision by Fri EOD to keep Mon start. thanks team. :thumbsup:
